standard: Literal visible labels are preserved. RTH and full ETH are separate references. Approximate prices read from axes are explicitly prefixed ~. An absent label is not supplied by inference. Prior review notes with generic 'prior value' are superseded where this ledger provides the literal label.

scope_dictionary.pRTHVAH / pdRTHVAH: Previous regular-trading-hours volume-profile value-area high. Different population from full-ETH pdVAH.
scope_dictionary.pdVAH / pdVAL: Previous full ETH trading-session value-area high/low, per user's explicit clarification. Preserve full session_id/clock definition.
scope_dictionary.pRTHH / pRTHL: Previous regular-session price high/low, not profile value edges.
scope_dictionary.PDH / PDL: Literal previous-day high/low; confirm source session scope rather than automatically aliasing to pRTHH/L.
scope_dictionary.RTHop / RTH op: Current regular-session opening print, known at instrument's regular open.
scope_dictionary.R-Hi / R-Lo / EQ: Time-based range price high/low/midpoint in these SDRangePlus charts; distinguish range open and RTHop.
scope_dictionary.ORH / ORM / ORL: Opening-range high/mid/low, with its own construction duration and known_at (5m/15m when specified).
scope_dictionary.POC: An unprefixed fixed reference line has profile scope that must be resolved using indicator settings/caption. Do not assign previous-RTH or ETH scope solely by color.
scope_dictionary.VAH / VAL on right-side developing VP: Current/developing profile edges at screenshot time, not previous-day values.
scope_dictionary.EVRange: AM expected-volatility range boundary; publicly shown boundaries do not disclose full source calculation.
